profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
Accounting professional with over 6 years of experience maintaining employee payroll accounts and managing billing and account receivables.  Keep track company’s contract budget and update the report every month.  Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and ability to produce quality work under strict deadlines.

Strong development skills in Web, Intranet, client-server technologies, and systems software development using JavaScript, HTML ASP,  and MS Access
In-depth knowledge of front end development skill
Extensive knowledge in VB three-tier application
Sound Analytical, problem solving and communication skills 
Hard working habit and always willing to learn latest technology in the market

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Modifying and editing PrintShop’s  website by using HTML, Javascript, and CSS.
•	Writing documentation for walkthrough tutorials on “how to use the software”.
•	Working with Manager calculate the product’s pricing for the website.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Providing software development services to the PECOS/OSS project for CMS by using XHTML, CSS, and JSP to develop a consistent user interface that is W3C and Section 508 compliant.Conducts unit testing and peer reviews on completed pages using multiple analysis software including W3C XHTML Validator, Deque 508 Validator and WAVE accessibility Validator. Redesign Medicare.gov website using ASP Pages, JavaScript, HTML, and IIS server.Ensured Section 508 Compliance.Test and solve any web relate issues.Using MS SQL to run query and updated records.Create Web sites using IIS/Windows Authentication in SQL Server 2000Experience working with four tier architectures (UI,BLL,DAL,DB)Self-motivated and team playerStrong Analytical Skills.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Support SEC EDGAR System with the existing TA Forms, EDGARLite, EDGARLink,     Online Web, and Query Report Form using XML, Java, javascript, html, and VBscript.

positions.title: Web Developer & Accounting Assistant
positions.description:
Managed accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll departments
Follows up on delinquent accounts
Maintains customer and receivable files
Generates and analyzes receivable reports
Enters invoices for payment
Processes time sheets and work reports
Inputs payroll
Prepares W-2s annually
Enters and maintains employee data
Reconciles bank accounts
Keep track LAM’s contract budget and update the value every month
Other duties include assisting the manager using MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Access to design and create reports for management         

Web Developer
      Web DeveloperSupport the Philadelphia Water Department with the ongoing project for Data    Collection and Scrubbing.  Main responsibilities include maintaining the website ( HYPERLINK) "http://www.pwdgis.net" www.pwdgis.net) for PWD team members within the  project.  
Modify and update the necessary changes in the site using ASP Pages, MS Access Database, and some Visual Basic Applications requested by the client.Creating weekly report by using MS Access Database.Design and maintain the corporate website, HYPERLINK "http://www.lamassoc.com" www.lamassoc.com.  This website was written in ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, HTML, Adobe Photoshop, and MS Access  running on IIS.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Analyze, design, develop, modify and maintain Lotus Notes databases.Modify corporate Intranet pages using Active Server Pages, Visual Basic, JavaScript and HTML.Design an application which was written in Lotus Notes.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Tracking of payments and collectables.  Update and maintain databases and files on the accounts which payments were received, and create reports for the collection department on past due accounts.  Data entry and generate reports using MS Word and Excel.  Assist senior accountants with their invoices, accounts, uncollectible, etc.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked alongside investors to learn strategies, trends, and rules of the financial market.Researched and aided the account managers with various projects for high profile clients.Analyzed optimal functions of funds to recommend the most viable solution.  Design, create, and maintain financial reports using MS Excel and MS Word.
